description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive and productive work environment. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in staff supervision, training, and maintaining compliance with all regulatory standards.

This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate and skilled nursing professional to advance their career within a supportive team. We offer a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 to $75,000, reflecting your experience and qualifications. If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents and leading a team of healthcare professionals, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 to $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Medical Assistant (MA) to join a dynamic healthcare facility in the Birmingham/Montgomery, AL area. This is a part-time/PRN opportunity, offering flexibility for professionals looking to balance their career with other commitments.

In this role, you will play a crucial part in supporting patient care, assisting physicians and other healthcare providers with administrative and clinical tasks. Responsibilities typically include preparing patients for examinations, taking vital signs, updating patient records, and assisting with minor procedures.

We value flexibility and are accommodating with interview scheduling, offering slots Monday through Friday from 1 PM to 7 PM, with additional availability over the weekend as needed.
requirements: Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) or Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) certification
Proven experience as a Medical Assistant in a clinical setting
Ability to perform basic clinical tasks and administrative duties
